unlisted_practices: Reversing the physician-AI relationship so the LLM directs the full diagnostic process with physicians as assistants
Accountability framework delineating responsibility for misdiagnoses between AI and physicians

screen.reason: The paper introduces DxDirector-7B, a model designed to drive full-process clinical diagnosis and evaluate diagnostic performance and workload reduction compared to other LLMs, but it benchmarks the newly developed model/paradigm rather than testing a specific deployable operational safeguard or practice.
